decisions.question: Force-push the rewritten history (data/export.bin purged) to shared main now?
decisions.context:
export.bin (2MB, in the initial commit) is fully purged from local history; .git shrank 2.2M → 212K.
origin/main still has the old history — replacing it needs a force-push.
Two contributors push to main daily: after the push they must re-clone or `git fetch && git reset --hard origin/main`, and any unpushed work of theirs needs rebasing.
